joint_constraints.rule: k_R = k_R_baseline * ET_scale and k_D = k_D_baseline * ET_scale
joint_constraints.reason: k_R and k_D are one approved coupled uncertainty axis.
Persistent RH saturation at the adverse corner; both one-axis boundary relaxations passed.
High irrigation at the low-Cd boundary exceeded unchanged humidity guards even at baseline ET.
C_d=0.30 was sufficient for high ET alone but not for simultaneous maximum irrigation and ET.
